title: Ro-Engineer: Roblox engineering standards
description: Always-on Roblox/Luau standards for any Studio script, system or bug: plan first, design before code. --!strict modules that return one table, no globals; task.spawn/defer/delay/wait, never legacy spawn/delay/wait; generalized iteration (for k, v in t do); export typed public interfaces; composition over inheritance; the simplest pattern that works. Server is authoritative: validate every remote payload (type, range, ownership, cooldown) and rate-limit. Disconnect every :Connect() and destroy or pool every instance on cleanup. Economy math on the server; know every currency's sources and sinks. Ro-Engineer by excaldev (MIT); verify against the project.
